campaigns.title: This Pitru Paksha, be a saviour of an abandoned elderly person left to die alone
campaigns.description: For elderly people left alone in the final chapters of their lives, abandonment can mean a life of suffering on the streets. A life filled with loneliness, insecurity and fear. Our NGO partner Neptune Foundation has been a pillar of support for countless such abandoned grandparents, neglected and destitute senior citizens, helping them find something that many thought they had lost forever, a safe place to call homeThe NGO sustains its old age home through public support and is in urgent needs for donations and funds to keep the shelter going. Your donation can go a long way in giving these elderly parents the home they deserve. Donate generously!Donate easily through UPI, all debit/credit cards and net banking.Charitable donations to this fundraising campaign are tax exempted under 80G of the Income Tax Act (India).A home when there is nowhere else to goNeptune Foundation provides free shelter, nutritious food, healthcare, companionship and emotional support to elderly people who have been abandoned, rejected or left without the means to care for themselves. Many residents are widowed, living alone, economically vulnerable, medically fragile or have experienced neglect and abuse.Today, 41 senior citizens between the ages of 60 and 95 live at the home. They receive hygienically prepared meals, regular medical check-ups, nursing and caregiving support, recreational and spiritual activities, and a safe residential environment. Here, an elderly person is not treated as a burden. Festivals, birthdays and cultural activities bring residents together, creating companionship and a sense of togetherness and belonging. The home welcomes seniors without discrimination based on caste, religion or background.Donate to give them a life filled with dignityThe need is growing. Neptune Foundation plans to expand its facility from 41 residents to up to 200 elderly people and establish a primary health centre serving residents as well as nearby rural communities.Your donation can help provide free food, shelter, medical care and daily support to elderly grandparents who have nowhere else to turn.Help Neptune Foundation give abandoned seniors more than a roof, a loving home, dignity, companionship and care. Donate today.Donate to this fundraiser by Give, India’s most trusted online donation platform, to support Neptune Foundation, in its mission to care for abandoned elderly grandparents.

campaigns.title: Help marginalized children claim a seat in the AI world
campaigns.description: Why we exist?Every technological revolution brings in progress, but not equally for everyone.The marginalized communities are often left to settle for entry-level jobs that are exploitative and prone to automation. They have limited voice on which problems get solved on priority. And the biases in society get embedded in and amplified through new technologies.How are we solving for it?Technology is power. Teaching it to marginalized children will help them claim a seat on the table. But in order for them to make right use of that power and steer technology towards creating an egalitarian world, we also need to build their character.So, teaching AI only through a technical lens is not sufficient. A holistic approach involves children understanding how it works, how it affects society and how to critically evaluate it.At THE labs, we try to do this through 3 interventions -AI Citizenship ProgramA 100-hour interdisciplinary program for middle-schoolers that aims to develop:Foundational understanding of all kinds of AI systemsAbility to critically evaluate AI systems for their impact on societyConfidence to adapt to various kinds of AI systems in the futureFellowship ProgramA 2-year residential program to prepare rural youth to be future educators and leaders in AI space by:Learning AI, Pedagogy, and LeadershipTeaching the AI Citizenship to children in government and aided schools.Developing a strong understanding of Indian social landscapeCentre of ExcellenceA community centre at Nanded City, Pune, that serves three main purposes -Opportunities for children to demonstrate their holistic learningResearch and development of new cutting-edge programsSafe space for children beyond school to spend time meaningfullyOur outreach in the current yearWe are working with more than 4000 children in urban, rural and tribal areas across 4 districts through 10 fellows, thanks to generous individuals like you who supported us last year.Read our annual impact reportWatch our children talking about their learnings and debating in classroomListen to our student sharing her research at an international conferenceTo expand this work further, we need your support!Our askDonate in this crowdfunding campaign. Below is how your donations will help us.INR 3,000 - Sponsor AI Citizenship Program for 1 child for a yearINR 15,000 - Sponsor AI Citizenship Program for 5 children for a yearINR 30,000 - Sponsor one month of a fellow's leadership journeyINR 50,000 - Sponsor one laptop that will be used by 400 children over 5 yearsTHE labs is the first organization in India to build a holistic AI program for children in grade 6 to 8. By donating any amount of your wish, you will join a community of more than 250 incredible supporters and become a pioneer in helping marginalized children claim a seat in the AI driven world.

campaigns.title: This Pitru Paksha, help feed warm meals to abandoned elderly and the destitute
campaigns.description: For thousands of elderly people, homeless individuals, daily-wage workers and vulnerable families, hunger is not an occasional hardship, it is a daily reality. Danirasa Foundation’s with the help of kind supporters and donors is quietly changing this reality for hundreds each day. Your donation provides a warm meal to an elderly grandparent who has no other means to survive. At ₹25 per meal, your donation of ₹1,250 can provide a meal each for 50 elders. Donate Now.Donate easily through UPI, all debit/credit cards and net banking.Charitable donations to this fundraising campaign are tax exempted under 80G of the Income Tax Act (India).From one crisis to a mission against hungerDanirasa Foundation’s journey began during the devastating 2015 Chennai floods. Founder Indu Priya witnessed families, especially women and children, struggling with displacement and hunger. She and her team mobilised volunteers to cook and distribute hot meals. What began as an emergency response became a lasting commitment to ensuring vulnerable communities have access to food with dignity and care.Today, Danirasa’s Community Kitchen serves around 4,900 people through this programme. The meals reach elderly residents in old-age homes, children from underserved communities, rehabilitation centres, homeless people, daily-wage workers and others facing food insecurity.A meal can mean so much moreFor an elderly person living without family support, a nutritious meal can bring comfort. For someone surviving on irregular daily wages, it can mean one less worry. For a vulnerable child, it can provide the nourishment needed to learn and grow.But feeding thousands of people every day requires a steady supply of ingredients, cooking, packaging, transportation and dedicated people.Help serve a meal with dignityYour donation can help Danirasa continue providing nutritious meals to homeless and elderly people, children, workers, persons with disabilities and families struggling to make ends meet.Help Danirasa ensure that no vulnerable person has to face the day with an empty stomach. Donate today.Donate to this fundraiser by give.do, India’s most trusted online donation platform, to support Danirasa Foundation, in its mission to feed helpless elderly and destitute people, who have no means of survival.

campaigns.title: Help Leena in saving girls from being lost forever in red-light areas
campaigns.description: "Hundreds of young girls are lost forever in the dark lanes of red-light areas," says Leena Kejriwal, the founder of Missing Link Trust. These girls endure unimaginable abuse and exploitation, being lured or trafficked into an industry that breaks them physically and emotionally. Missing Link Trust is on a mission to prevent the tragedy before it happens, and also rehabilitate girls and women who are rescued from forced sex work.Leena’s journey began with her powerful street art project in Kolkata, where she painted haunting silhouettes of missing girls to raise awareness against sex trafficking. Now, she leads a larger fight — one that focuses on prevention and rehabilitation. But this mission needs your support.You can save countless girl children from going missing forever. Donate now.Donate easily through UPI, all debit/credit cards and net banking. Charitable donations to this fundraising campaign are tax exempted under 80G of the Income Tax Act (India).Preventing Trafficking Before It Begins“When girls come into a red-light area, the first thing is that they are broken, physically and emotionally,” Leena says. “It’s like they will be caught, hands and legs tied, and all heinous crimes committed on them.” These are the brutal realities that Missing Link Trust fights against every day.Many of these girls are from impoverished regions like the Sundarbans, and traffickers prey on their vulnerability. “It’s shocking that they sell themselves for as low as a hundred rupees,” Leena adds. "They ready her through violent acts, removing all threads of shame from her."But why wait until a girl is trafficked to save her? Missing Link Trust believes in stopping trafficking at its root — through “prevention, prevention, prevention” as Leena puts it. The goal is simple: protect girls from ever being lost to this darkness.A Safe World for Children“Our mission is the prevention of abuse and exploitation of children,” Leena emphasizes. “Our vision is to create a safe world for children, and we want to do this with a preventive methodology.”Every Donation MattersYour support will help Missing Link Trust continue its vital work of rescuing, rehabilitating, and preventing the trafficking of young girls. The funds raised will go directly towards:Prevention programs in vulnerable areas to stop trafficking before it happens.Rehabilitation services for girls rescued from red-light areas, providing them with medical care, emotional support, and education.Awareness campaigns to reach at-risk communities and ensure girls are protected from traffickers.Together, We Can Make a Difference“Why wait for a girl to get trafficked to save her?” asks Leena. With your help, we can stop this horror before it begins. Your donation will help us create a world where no girl is lost to the nightmare of trafficking.Donate to this fundraiser by Give, India’s largest and most trusted online giving platform, to support Missing Link Trust to save young girls from being trafficked and help rehabilitate those rescued.

campaigns.title: Help abandoned elderly with shelter and care
campaigns.description: Every day, elderly parents are left alone on the streets, at train stations, or even outside temples. Many are sick, struggling with age-related problems, and have no money or family to turn to. Some suffer for weeks or months before anyone notices their pain. The heartbreaking truth? They were abandoned by their own families.Although Indian law requires children and relatives to care for senior citizens, many elders still face neglect, abuse, and abandonment. The problem is only getting worse.But there is hope. Our dedicated NGO partners work day and night to rescue these forgotten elders. They provide safe shelter, medical care, nutritious meals, and most importantly—love and respect. Through old age homes across the country, our partners give these seniors a chance to live their remaining years with dignity, comfort, and peace.You can make a difference. Your donation will help our NGO partners:Rescue homeless elders from the streetsProvide shelter, food, and medical careRestore their faith in humanity with kindness and supportNo elder should spend their final years alone and suffering. Your generosity can give them a fresh start. Donate today and help an abandoned senior citizen find safety, care, and hope.

campaigns.title: Sponsor Living Expenses for Single Women
campaigns.description:
The women in the age group of 18-35 years are living single due to destitute, divorced, widowed, separated, unmarried, infected/affected with HIV/AIDS, survivors of violence against women (VAW) living single, and living separately with disabilities. These women lead their families by doing daily labor, wage workers, and street vendors, but they get limited daily income, and due to the nonavailability of work, they have no workdays in a month; as a result, they don’t have income those days; this will lead these families to severe poverty conditions. Hence, the young single women searching for alternative income sources and trapped by the middlemen to use them as sex workers while they are involved in sex work, infected with HIV/AIDS, and facing many other health issues; they lose their dignity in the society, they can’t do further for labor work to generate income for their family. Mahila Margadarshi conducted a study with these families about their income sources and wellbeing; we identified that most of these women have various skills in sewing, food preparation, little shops, skilled in developing backyard poultry, and trading with goat/sheep lambs. But, due to a lack of financial feasibility, these women are working as unskilled labor and getting insufficient income to manage their families. Due to the situation, the family members face no food days and become malnourished. This will affect the lives of these families. 
 The proposed project ‘Living Expenses for a Single Women Family’ addresses the poverty issue among 100 single women families and provide financial assistance to the women according to their skill to earn money at their home, provide financial aid to developing backyard poultry, purchase goat/sheep lambs for rearing, buy a sewing machine for income generation, start a little shop at home to lead by their parents. The financial aid to these single women will bring them out of the severe poverty conditions and improve their dignity in society; Mahila Margadarshi will take responsibility for protecting the young single women from the middlemen and take the lead role in accessing the benefits of all Government Schemes. 
 The project will address the issues of poverty and dignity, the project beneficiaries will improve their family income which will lead to zero hunger days in a month, and the young single women will start their enterprise at home to earn income and prevent the pressure from the middlemen in the society; as a result, they are not infected with HIV/AIDs and reduce the rate HIV infections, the survivors of Violence Against Women will stand firm for accessing justice.

campaigns.title: Jan-Manas COVID-19 Prevention Drive in Remote Indo-Nepal Border Areas
campaigns.description:
The porous Indo-Nepal border is a potential source of the spread of coronavirus in India. There are about 40 remote villages we have identified along the Indo-Nepal border in Uttar Pradesh with extremely poor and backward communities. As the Covid-19 pandemic spreads to rural locations, these people are left unprepared and unequipped to protect themselves from being infected. While the government is taking measures to spread awareness and create vaccination camps, they are not accessible to many vulnerable sections of the community, like the aged, disabled, cancer patients, pregnant women and children. Many are unable to visit the camps themselves, which are in nearby villages. There is a need to reach out to them at their doorstep to educate them, protect them and prepare them to fight the pandemic. 
 Jan Manas Vikas Sansthan has been working closley with the backward communities along Indo-Nepal border in Uttar Pradesh for many years, through poverty alleviation, education, healthcare and women empowerment. Today, as COVID-19 reaches these remote villages, we are aware of the critical need to prepare these communities to protect themselves and access the facilities provided by the government. We have identified 40 remote villages along Indo-Nepal border to reach about 80,000 vulnerable people from extremely backward communities. We will work towards prevention of COVID-19 in these communities through door-to-door awareness drives, provision of masks and safety kits, and transportation to nearest vaccination camps in the area. We will also support the poor in post-COVID care through provision of nutrotious food and supplements. Join us in this critical and urgent COVID-prevention drive. 
 The impact of our COVID-prevention activities in backward communities include,Widespread COVID-19 awareness amongst 80,000+ peopleAccess to masks and other safety measures amongst 80,000+ peopleAccess to vaccination for 15,000+ vulnerable people, like aged, disabled, women and cancer patientsAccess to post-COVID nutrition to the economically challenged families

campaigns.title: Nutrition & Medicines to Support Rural Pregnant Women for Safe Labour / Delivery
campaigns.description:
In our working area, the deprived rural women, especially the pregnant are in pathetic-vulnerable condition. As they are infected by pandemic disease, the pregnant women are having poor health status and immunity. Thus it is the timely need to support them by providing multivitamins and nutritional products for making them gain strength and assisting medical supports and timely guidance till her delivery. However the Government has given supplementary nutrition to the local village level Balwadis which is given to children but not to pregnant women specifically. Hence this project helps them to providing supplementary Nutrition and Medicines during her pregnancy period, improved their health status and immunity power and helps her to make her labour / delivery in a safe and secured manner. 
 We would like to give the support for 6 months (Two Trimesters). Pregnancy is confirmed around the 3rd month, we look after the women in their last 2 trimesters) We have identified about 178 women are currently in Pregnancy and Caring status in our working block those are poor living conditions who unable to meet their daily expenses, they are struggling for their daily breads and unable to access their health care measures, especially by intake of nutrition food and medicines.. The health and education status of them are very poor.By this project, we have to give “Supplementary Nutritional Pack” which contains, pulses, cereals and greens vegetables, dry fruits etc., and a Medicines kit including Folic Tablets, Vitamin Capsules, Multi Vitamin Tablets, Zinc Tonic etc.,. Each of the 20 women which we would like to support this project will be provided by these items at free of cost and this Supplementary Nutrition Pack and Medicines Kit will be given to Pregnant women for 6 months period (Two Trimesters from 3rd month of pregnancy)We have so far supported 18 (pregnant women infected by HIV/AIDS) cases during the year 2017 & 2018 through various health welfare schemes of government and private agencies We have already good follow-up in our Field through the ORW and we have regular touch they are coming and we are going to their houses so it is not difficult us to meet the every month and taking them to hospital.Under this program we have to support only minimum quantity and restricted population of women in our working area but we need to cover additional women beneficiaries whom are intend need. So as we made this donation option for continuing this project. 
 This option helps to improve the Health status of the rurally poor Pregnant women and affected by HIV/ AIDS and Anemic causes. By providing “Supplementary Nutritional Pack” which contains, pulses, cereals and greens vegetables, dry fruits etc., and a Medicines kit including Folic Tablets, Vitamin Capsules, Multi Vitiamin Tablets, Zinc Tonic etc.,. Each of the 20 women which we would like to support this project will be provided by these items at free of cost and this Supplementary Nutrition Pack and Medicines Kit will be given to Pregnant women for 6 months period (Two Trimesters from 3rd month of pregnancy) will certainly helps to improve their health status and Immunity power and prepared them physically fit to make a very Safe, Secure and normal delivery during labour.

campaigns.title: Sponsoring Vital Medicines, Bedsheets, Protective Cloths to Disadvantaged and Uncared Elders
campaigns.description:
SAMUKA MUNNETRA SANGAM (SMS) is a legally registered NGO (Society) working for the welfare of the poor and deprived women and children since 2013. In our project area, the condition of the deprived rural elders is very poor. About 65% of them are uncared for by their relatives. They depend on their son or son-in-law for their basic living and health care needs. Few of them involve landless agri-coolie and others work with meager wages, struggling for their daily bread. They live in small huts in remote villages and slum area. Because of age and illness, they do not perform well at work and are unable work on regular basis. Hence the income level is very low, not even sufficient to buy protective clothing during rainy seasons or to purchase basic health care medicines. The condition of elder widow women is more pitiful; they are denied basic support by their siblings and not even allowed to talk with their grand children. They live with buried feelings.  
 About 148 cases are identified as pro-poor elders, widow elders those are very pathetic in condition in our working area. They live a semi-orphan life at their sibling’s house with careless support. We have to support about 60 of them who are in critical need of support. They are infected by disease and have poor health status and immunity. Through this proposed intervention, we have to provide bedsheets, protective cloths and basic health care medicines, multivitamins for helping them gain strength to cope with their normal lifestyle. We also wish to provide timely guidance and counseling support to ventilate their buried inner feelings till their lifetime. We have so far supported 28 (poor elders and widow elders in our rural working villages) during the year 2017 & 2018 through various health welfare schemes of government and private agencies. We already have a good follow-up in our field through the staffs. 
 This option helps to support over 60 more rural poor elders, widow elders in the rural working area. This donation will highly help to get basic cloths, bedsheets, protective cloths during rainy seasons and will help to cut off the expenses of their medical care expenses, purchase of Vital Medicines, especially the purchase of medicines and vital drugs needed for their life saving. So that they can able to lead their normal lifestyle and cope with their belonging society. About 60 more rural poor disadvantaged elders, particularly elders widow women would get benefited by donations to this project and would have access to basic clothing and basic needs.
